body_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve. Create an exact 3 columns by 2 rows transparent sprite sheet of SIX full-body detailed pixel-art poses of the SAME young HUMAN herbal healer in input identity reference. Keep his black layered hair, quiet young face, low broad woven dark bamboo/leaf hat with thin gold ribs and hanging leaf pendants, gray-teal robe, dark green leaf mantle, rope bindings, two small medicine gourds on waist, open-toed wrapped sandals, and ONE twisted wooden staff with a large open vine RING at top, gold ties and hanging leaves. HUMAN hands with one thumb each, no animal ears or tail. Consistent three-quarter view facing SCREEN RIGHT; no mirror switching. Staff stays on the character's screen-left side in the SAME holding hand throughout, free casting hand on screen-right.
Important: this character's main action is HEALING, not a damaging weapon strike. He stands calmly with BOTH sandal soles on the SAME ground footprint. Staff bottom planted vertically at the SAME point through every cell; staff and support hand stationary. No step, jump, floating or spin. Keep the lower body, feet, hat scale, staff ring size, and camera scale MATCHED in all six cells; all motion comes from the free arm, fingers, subtle shoulders, head focus and trailing robe/leaf tips. Preserve natural elbow/wrist connections; each open hand shows a correct palm and thumb, not a fist backwards.
Layout landscape, equal cells with very wide clear alpha gutters. Every complete staff ring, hat feather, hanging leaf, fingertip, and sandal fully INSIDE its cell with at least 35px empty alpha at ALL edges. All figures same size. Crisp stepped-pixel edges, rich but solid clustered shading like a detailed game sprite, no smooth antialias, no soft illustration blur, no floor/shadow/background, no text or grid.
Read six poses left-to-right:
1 READY: staff held securely with screen-left hand, free right-side hand relaxed by waist, eyes looking right. Soles planted, neutral gentle healer focus.
2 GATHER: free elbow bends, palm comes inward to chest facing slightly upward; shoulders subtly prepare, support staff hand and lower body stay fixed.
3 CHARGE: open free palm raises in front of chest, fingers relaxed cupped, wrist straight; focused gaze follows it. Not two hands holding the staff.
4 RELEASE HEAL: free forearm extends toward screen right, palm open and slightly upward, fingers spread naturally; sleeve follows the elbow, shoulder slightly forward. Do not extend a second ghost arm.
5 FOLLOW THROUGH: free wrist eases outward/upward a little while elbow stays extended; torso settles, leaf/robe tips gently follow. Both feet and staff still planted in identical footprint.
6 RETURN: elbow retracts halfway toward chest with palm relaxed down, preparing to return to ready; not a different idle copied backwards.
No visible spell, beam, fire, circle, crosses, light halo or magic particles attached to any of these six bodies. Spell effects will be a SEPARATE asset. True transparent background.
fx_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A transparent sheet of independent game VFX for a calm herbal healer's single healing spell, detailed crisp PIXEL ART, no characters, no hands, no weapons, no environment, no text, no crosses or icons. EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows of widely separated small effects, each comfortably surrounded by transparent alpha. Color: soft jade green, pale yellow-green, cream-gold highlights; gentle plant magic, not orange fire or toxic smoke.
Top row: 1 a small pale jade pearl surrounded by 3 tiny green leaves and a few gold pixels, charging; 2 a slightly brighter round jade light with 4 tiny leaves gently circling it, charging; 3 a compact healing projectile travelling SCREEN RIGHT, a rounded cream-green leading light on RIGHT, a few detailed small sage leaves and a short tapered translucent mint trail pointing LEFT.
Bottom row: 4 same projectile later in flight, just a slightly smaller leaf trail, same color and direction; 5 a sparse cluster of 5 tiny sage-green leaves and pale gold sparks dispersing outward, no central ball; 6 an even fainter small group of 3 green leaves and 4 pale sparks settling. Deliberately pixel-stepped silhouettes and clusters, NO fuzzy gaussian glow, NO broad opaque haze. The pearl and each projectile should remain compact, never a giant beam. Genuine transparent background including all gutters, no grid/border/shadow.
